title: table (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. A small grid of values: rows of things by a few columns of numbers, with an optional total, sortable on the device.

label.description: The column heading: App, Installs, Revenue, Change.

format.description: How the column’s values are formatted. delta: a signed change with an arrow, coloured by good.

currency.description: ISO 4217 for format currency (or a delta in currency).

unit.description: Unit after each value: ms, GB, kWh.

delta_format.description: For format delta: how the change is shown.

good.description: For format delta: which direction is good. Required for delta columns, so a cost going up is never green.

align.description: Defaults to end for numbers, start for text.

mono.description: Monospaced text: file paths, ids, hashes.

width.description: A width hint. The first column takes the rest.

columns.description: The columns in order. The first names the row. Up to 4 fit on an iPhone; more reflow.

value.description: The raw value in the column’s format; null when unknown (shown as —).

display.description: A pre-formatted string when the format can’t say it.

state.description: Draws the cell as a tag in this state (glyph and word): a failing job, an overspent category.

anyOf.description: A cell that needs more than a raw value.

additionalProperties.description: A raw value (number, text, or null for unknown) or a cell object.

items.description: One row: cells keyed by column key. Keys not in columns are rejected by the tool.

rows.description: The rows in the order to show them.

value.description: The raw value in the column’s format; null when unknown (shown as —).

display.description: A pre-formatted string when the format can’t say it.

state.description: Draws the cell as a tag in this state (glyph and word): a failing job, an overspent category.

anyOf.description: A cell that needs more than a raw value.

additionalProperties.description: A raw value (number, text, or null for unknown) or a cell object.

total.description: An optional total row, keyed like the rows. Never send a total that isn’t the sum (or the stated aggregate) of the rows; leave the cell null when any value is unknown.

sortable.description: Tapping a column heading sorts on the device (again reverses). Local; the agent is never asked.

noun.description: Plural for Show all: “apps” → “Show all 4 apps”.
